stem: Rivers belonging to which one of the following groups form the boundary between Bihar and Uttar Pradesh?
expl: The Karmanasa, Gandak and Ghaghara rivers determine the boundary line between Uttar Pradesh and Bihar. The Karmanasa merges into the Ganga near Chausa of Buxar, the Gandak near Pahleja Ghat (Saran district), and the Ghaghara near Revelganj (Saran district).

stem: The other name of the Gandak River is—
expl: Among the given options, the other name of the Gandak River is “Narayani”. Another name of it is “Shaligrami” as well. It is noteworthy that the Gandak River originates from the Nepal Himalayas and meets the Ganga near Pahleja Ghat. The Gandak River has 7 main tributaries—Trishuli, Budhi Gandak, Seti, Daraudi, Madi, Kali Gandak, and Marsyangdi.

stem: Which river of Bihar is known for changing its course?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: The Kosi River is known for its continuous change of course. The Kosi is formed by the confluence of three rivers—Sun Koshi, Arun Koshi and Tamur Koshi. All these rivers originate from the Himalayan region of Nepal and Tibet. The original name of the Kosi is Kaushiki. Due to its tendency to change course, it is called the ‘Sorrow of Bihar’. It joins the Ganga near Kursela (Katihar).
